body: ExtremeGC increased physical free space from 2.825 GiB to 25.701 GiB. Four DeletionProofs cover 23.780 logical GiB; physical gain was 22.876 GiB. The dominant source was a noncanonical append-only estate compiler explicitly disallowed by frozen V8.1 direction. Its KeepAlive writer is disabled and unloaded. Current authority, operator, credentials, Run8 state, execution environments and Docker volumes remain protected.
subject: ExtremeGC funds 25.7 GiB working reserve and retires noncanonical writer
